names.onboard.intro: Your hub, your keys, your friends. Your identity is created on this computer and never leaves it.
names.onboard.intro.web: Your hub, your keys, your friends. Your identity is made in this browser and sealed with your passkey: your storage node keeps it without being able to read it.

names.web.unlock.intro: Your account on this browser is sealed. Open it with your passkey or your recovery words.
names.onboard.words.title: Your recovery words
names.onboard.words.write: Write these 24 words down on paper, in order. They are shown only now.
names.onboard.words.why: They are your identity: with them you set up another computer, replace a stolen key and rotate your keys. Weave never stores them. Keep them away from this computer, from chats and from AI agents: whoever has them is you.
names.onboard.words.why.web: They are your identity: with them you set up another device, replace a stolen key and rotate your keys. They also lie sealed at your storage node, so your passkey can bring your account to a new browser. Keep them away from chats and from AI agents: whoever has them is you.

Weave fetches the file, refuses it unless its SHA-256 is the one in the signed release, unpacks it and starts it in its own folder. While it runs it can also post in the project as this website, and the settings you give it (keys) go to it in the clear.
